Clever! - Das Spiel, das Wissen Schafft.name: I Heart Geeks!
Clever! - Das Spiel, das Wissen Schafft.summary: I Heart Geeks! is the ultimate puzzle experience, challenging you to create sophisticated and humorous contraptions using dozens of objects and the laws of real-world physics to solve over 100 brain teasers. Produced in cooperation with Marc Ecko Entertainment, the game features a tongue-in-cheek story and hip art style where the brainy Geek overcomes the brawny (and bullying) Jocks, winning the heart of the beautiful Cheerleader.

Digimon World - Dawn.name: Digimon World Dawn
Digimon World - Dawn.summary: Digimon World Dawn, originally released as Digimon Story Sunburst in Japan, is a Digimon video game for the Nintendo DS handheld game console. It was released in Japan on March 29, 2007 and North America on September 18, 2007. It serves as the second game in the Digimon Story series, though it was marketed as a game within the Digimon World series in North America.

Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles - Echoe.name: Final Fantasy: Crystal Chronicles - Echoes of Time
Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles - Echoe.summary: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: Echoes of Time is an installment in the Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles series. It is the first Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles game that allows players to play together online and it allows players who own a Nintendo Wii or Nintendo DS to play together at the same time using the Pollux Engine, an Engine created by Square Enix.

Littlest Pet Shop 3 - Biggest Stars - Pu.name: Littlest Pet Shop 3: Biggest Stars - Purple Team
Littlest Pet Shop 3 - Biggest Stars - Pu.summary: Get ready to go for the gold! It's time to hit the arena for the LITTLEST PET SHOP Biggest Stars competition—and this time your pets are in the spotlight! Ten fun and challenging mini games are your pets' tickets to the big time. Practice makes perfect as you help your pets become the best gymnasts, models, ice skaters, dancers, flyers, fashion designers, and more. Then pack up their cute team uniforms and the dozens of super-fun accessories you've customized because it's time to hit the road! The Biggest Stars competition is the event of year, when the pet-triplet judges look for teams that are a triple threat; cute, peppy and totally talented! Good thing that with your help, all your LITTLEST PET SHOP pet's Biggest Stars dreams really can come true!

Manga-ka Debut Monogatari DS - Akogare!.name: Manga-Ka Debut Monogatari DS: Akogare! Manga Ka Ikusei Game
Manga-ka Debut Monogatari DS - Akogare!.summary: Manga Ka Debut Monogatari DS: Akogare! Manga Ka Ikusei Game is a Simulation game, developed by Hyde and published by TDK Core, which was released in Japan in 2005.

Postman Pat - Special Delivery Service.name: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service
Postman Pat - Special Delivery Service.summary: A hidden object game based on the English TV show.

Spider-Man - Shattered Dimensions.name: Spider-Man: Shattered Dimensions
Spider-Man - Shattered Dimensions.summary: The Nintendo DS version of Spider-Man: Shattered Dimensions is a side-scrolling brawler with metroidvania elements.

Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken Tan - Kam.name: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan: Kamen Genei Satsujin Jiken
Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken Tan - Kam.summary:
The first case from the Tantei Ryousuke Jiken-tan series remastered for Nintendo DS.

Detective Ryosuke Kaokawa Case Story Masked Phantom Murder Case" for NDS is a work that ported the adventure game "Detective Ryousuke Kibukawa Case File" series distributed by the company for mobile phones to NDS. The story is the original version of the NDS version. The game system also uses NDS's unique functions, and improvements have been made, such as touching the face of the person you want to talk to, and displaying different information on the upper and lower screens.

The player becomes the scenario writer Masao Ikurumi, and challenges to solve the difficult case with Itsuna Shirasagisu, who works as an assistant under the detective Ryosuke Kibukawa. This time, it seems that we will investigate an incident that occurs in a port town, but the detailed story has not been revealed.

Compared to mobile apps, the operability of NDS has been greatly improved. In addition, it has been released from capacity constraints, and the quality of the graphics has also been greatly improved. It is the first title to be released on a consumer game console, but I also want to pay attention to its high quality.

Zaidan Houjin Nihon Kanji Nouryoku Kente.name: 250-man-nin no Kanken Premium: Zenkyuu Zen-Kanji Kanzen Seiha
Zaidan Houjin Nihon Kanji Nouryoku Kente.summary: Educational game focused on studying kanji drawing for The Japan Kanji Aptitude Test, Kanji Kentei (Kanken).
